artist.name: Rosie Darling
artist.place_of_origin: Boston, Massachusetts, United States (born); Los Angeles, California (based)
artist.short_description: Boston-born, Los Angeles-based singer-songwriter whose candid indie-pop songs revisit love, friendship, loss, and personal growth.
artist.biography: Rosie Darling is the performing name of Rosemary Darling, a singer-songwriter born in Boston and based in Los Angeles. In a 2021 interview, she said that Rosie was already her everyday nickname, making it a natural stage name. Her early independent songs led to the release of 'Coping' in 2020, followed by the six-track 'Coping' EP in 2021. Discussing the project, Darling emphasized its grounding in the complicated emotions that accompany romance, friendship, heartbreak, and loneliness. Her songwriting is personal, but she has also spoken about wanting listeners to locate their own experiences inside the songs. The 2022 'Golden Age' EP expanded her storytelling. In a track-by-track interview she connected its title song to grief, isolation, and emotional upheaval during the pandemic, while 'Always Almost' explored the idea of someone who got away. Her debut album 'Lanterns' arrived in 2023 through Nettwerk. In subsequent interviews she characterized that collection as a challenging process of unpacking painful experiences and described 'Boxes' as particularly important to her recovery. For Afterglow, Darling provides an intimate link between soft heartbreak pop and reflective coming-of-age songwriting. That last categorization is editorial, rather than a formal description supplied by the artist.
